title: OWASP Top 10: 2025
description: The OWASP Top 10:2025 is the latest standard awareness document for developers and web application security, representing the consensus on critical application security risks.

title: OWASP SQL Injection Prevention Cheat Sheet
description: Guidance on defending applications against SQL Injection vulnerabilities through parameterized queries, object relational mapping, and input validation.

title: OWASP OS Command Injection Defense Cheat Sheet
description: Techniques for preventing OS command injection vulnerabilities by avoiding system shells, utilizing argument lists, and restricting parameter values.

title: OWASP Cross Site Scripting Prevention Cheat Sheet
description: Strategies for eliminating Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) through contextual output encoding, safe sinks, and Content Security Policy (CSP).

title: OWASP Deserialization Cheat Sheet
description: Best practices for avoiding insecure deserialization in Java, Python, and other environments using safe formats and object filtering.

title: OWASP Cryptographic Storage Cheat Sheet
description: Architectural guidelines for strong encryption algorithms, key management, avoiding broken algorithms like MD5/SHA-1, and secure hashing.

title: OWASP Authentication Cheat Sheet
description: Comprehensive guidance on authentication best practices including password storage with Argon2/bcrypt, hardcoded credential detection, MFA, brute-force protection, and secure session management.

title: OWASP Input Validation Cheat Sheet
description: Strategies for robust server-side input validation including allowlist validation, SQL injection prevention, OS command injection prevention, path traversal, and encoding guidance.

title: OWASP Secrets Management Cheat Sheet
description: Guidelines for securely managing credentials, API keys, tokens, and secrets — covering hardcoded secrets detection, secrets managers (Vault, AWS, Azure), rotation, log redaction, and Git hygiene.
